senses.gloss: m. (Arab. bazr, abzār, v. בזר, פזר) anything used for seasoning, spices &c.—Fig. requisites, appurtenances.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 74b:9">Snh. 74ᵇ</cite> <he>אינהו וכל אבזרייהו</he> they (the commands) and all appertaining thereto.
<cite ref="Menachot 73b:13">Men. 73ᵇ</cite> <he>עולה וכל אֲבִיזְרָהָא</he> Ar. a. Rashi to Snh. l. c. (ed. <cite ref="H00078"><he>חבירתא</he></cite> corr. acc.) the burnt-offering and &c.
